title: Open Mic @ The Bistro
event_description: Open mic night at Hayward's most beloved live music venue. All musicians welcome to perform original music or covers. Also hosts jazz and blues jam sessions on weekends.
event_venue_information:
The Bistro - East Bay's Premier Music Venue

The Bistro has been Hayward's home for live music craft beer and great memories since 1994. This beloved neighborhood music venue features live music seven nights a week with Mondays reserved for open mic. The Bistro has become an institution in the East Bay described as one of the few oasis of live music in the region.

Live Music Programming

With live music EVERY DAY and no cover charge the venue offers exceptional value for music fans. Mondays feature open mic nights where local musicians perform originals and covers. Weekend programming includes jazz jam sessions blues performances and local band rotations. The Bistro provides an intimate setting that feels like a neighborhood gathering spot rather than a corporate venue.

Atmosphere & Amenities

The Bistro maintains a casual friendly vibe with paper tablecloths and crayons for drawing. Twenty craft beers on tap rotating Belgian beers and over 50 beers to go. Fine wines are available alongside cold drinks. The outdoor patio provides comfortable seating. No cover charges mean you pay only for drinks and company.

Community Focus

Since 1994 The Bistro has built deep roots in downtown Hayward. Regular patrons describe counting on finding a familiar face behind the bar. The venue functions as more than a bar - it's a true neighborhood home away from home. Live music quality varies across the week but the commitment to supporting local musicians remains constant.
